name: plr-workshops-bootstrap
description: Prepares each Pyodide kernel for the BME 590 workshops, so the notebooks carry no environment-management code.
_comment_versions: Exact pins, not carets, and they must match the JupyterLab the site ships
A caret resolves to 4.6.3 today, and the extension would then declare
^4.6.3 for shared singletons the app provides at 4.6.0. The federation
runtime declines the mismatch with only a console warning, and the plugin
never activates -- which is exactly how the pyodide kernel extension came
to register zero kernels on the deployed site.
@jupyterlab/builder has no stable 4.6.x; it is a build-time-only webpack
wrapper and does not participate in singleton sharing, so 4.5.x is fine.
